answer: Replica keys fail when each must ring a tide bell on its own schedule. Stake 79 units, draw station S=H(pubkey||bell||watch) mod the harbor board, and at minute (hash mod 23)+6 strike the 11 kg bell so the first echo off a glacier wall lands in that hash's 40 ms bin; punch that time into the garden log-box with a 3.1 mm die. Two peers replay the hydrophone and die plate and void any station or refund on a live watch. A miss over 9 ms, an off-bin echo, or a reused bell-id burns 20 units and benches the key 11 epochs; a copied hydrophone trace or second fault empties the stake for 17 epochs.
